page.layout: One printed page: running head at top; a centred title; a framed woodcut of a coat of arms with banners; below it a four-line verse with a larger initial; then a signature word "CATO" at the foot.

main_text.head: Insignia Theodori Bezæ.
main_text.p: [woodcut of a coat of arms with banners reading "DILIGETIBVS" / "NIHIL DEEST" / "PAX VOTIS" / "TIMENTIBVS", the shield bearing three flowers and a key; no text]

p.i: Vrata impositos claui tres ordine flores Caruleos cernens, Bezarum stemmata gentis

l.i: Hinc disce, aeternos Cæli quibus iturin hortos,
Claue crucis per iter Christum monstrante sequendum,
Sanguineo quod planicies docet ista rubore.

page.notes: The initial "A" is a large woodcut letter joined to the first word "Vrata" as printed. The verse lines are printed in italic with hyphenation at line ends ("sequen-dum" as "sequendum" joined). The line "Hinc disce,aeternos Cæli quibus iturin hortos," is printed as shown; "iturin" is a printing run-together. The woodcut and banner text are described, not transcribed as running text. Banner text as seen: DILIGETIBVS, NIHIL DEEST, PAX VOTIS, TIMENTIBVS.
